programme.desc: S03 E05 — Nightmares in New England Retta's journey to find scary takes her to New England where four homes battle for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria. It includes a large house with whistling and humming specters and a duplex.
programme.title: Scariest House in America

programme.desc: S03 E06 — From Frightening to Fabulous After a season-long search, the road trip comes to an end and Retta reveals the Scariest House in America; designer Alison Victoria faces her ultimate renovation challenge: transform the terrifying home with a stunning $150,000 makeover.
programme.title: Scariest House in America

programme.desc: S02 E01 — Stay for A-Wild Jack McBrayer hits the road to find unique homes in the U.S. and kicks things off at a home shaped like an actual shoe; he checks out an off-the-grid eco-house and stops by a hitmaker's hideaway.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S02 E02 — Where the Trolls Live Jack explores more unique and wild homes including a jam-packed mansion with a 25-seat movie theater, a replica mineshaft home situated on over 300 acres and a mountain home featuring a jungle theme and hidden rooms.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S02 E05 — Fit for a King and Queen Jack continues his trip across the US and explores a grandiose castle, a reimagined church, and a sprawling ranch; an open house welcomes potential buyers, but only one can be crowned the wildest of the bunch.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S02 E06 — Halo Effect Jack's search for wild homes continues with more houses for sale: an artist's Technicolor high-rise and a serene angelic retreat; he visits a newly bought round home that has no flat walls or angles.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S02 E09 — Triple Threat Jack's wild search takes him to a triple geodesic dome home created by the owner and a suburban house designed top to bottom with marble; he visits a newly-purchased Arizona ghost town to discover how the owners plan to bring it back to life.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S02 E10 — Let's Get It Tron Jack finds a Dallas home for sale inspired by sci-fi movies plus another in Taos, New Mexico, known as the Adobe Castle that doubles as an art museum; he also visits an earth home bought by a woman who drove 15 hours to make an offer on it.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S272 E02 — I'm Not a Hoarder After 25 years of marriage, journalism professors look for their first home in Murfreesboro, Tennessee. They need a place that fit all the family treasures she's accumulated, and she doesn't mind spending more to get it, but he's unwilling to budge.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S281 E01 — The Purrfect House After surviving cancer, a woman and her blind cat are ready to live big and buy a home in Atlanta; she's an attorney who specializes in construction defects and wants something modern, but to her mom's dismay, she spots flaws everywhere she looks.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S276 E04 — Ghosts of Hollywood A buyer has lived below his means in a Los Angeles apartment for decades, and now at 60, he's ready to live large; he wants a grand home in the Hollywood Hills, but his kids are worried and caution against going too big at his age.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: First a House Then a Wedding in Winston-Salem A couple's ready to start planning their wedding, but first they have to find a house with enough space for their family in Winston-Salem, North Carolina. She wants an older Craftsman or midcentury, but he's looking for something modern and updated.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S279 E02 — Transition: Impossible He's ready to bail on Boston, but she's a Beantown-lifer unsure if Texas is the right fit; she wants a New England charmer to ease the transition while he prefers something modern, but this move may not happen if they can't agree on a compromise.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S279 E07 — The Hamptons Hustle After living with roommates and saving up, a young couple's ready to find a home in ritzy East Hampton, New York; he wants nothing less than a glitzy chef's kitchen, but she prefers nothing more than a little cottage.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S280 E08 — Whiskey Tango Foxtrot A military couple bought their home sight unseen in Savoy, Ill., and it's not working for her; she wants design projects and plenty of land for animals, but he's resisting another move since they could be relocated again in the near future.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S272 E07 — They're Tracking Our Phones An engaged couple hunts for a home of their own before they marry in Pennsylvania. He wants a fixer with character while she prefers something updated that's move-in ready, but with their parents involved, setting boundaries may be a challenge.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S264 E05 — On Her Own in Nashville A twenty-something real estate agent and brain tumor survivor is eager to buy her first home in Nashville, Tenn; she wants a single-family home that's near the city, but her mother would rather see her in a newer, low-maintenance townhome.
programme.title: House Hunters
